say:1:1620231001:1.text: Silven accepts the sword and solemnly fastens it at his waist. At that instant, he appears more composed and resolute than ever.
say:1:1620231001:1.source_cn: 休接过这柄属于他的佩剑，庄重地将它佩在腰间，这一瞬间，...
say:1:1620231001:1.male: Silven accepts the sword and solemnly fastens it at his waist. At that instant, he appears more composed and resolute than ever.
say:1:1620231001:1.female: Silven accepts the sword and solemnly fastens it at his waist. At that instant, he appears more composed and resolute than ever.

say:3:1620231002:1.text: Sir Silven Grenvalden, how are you feeling now?
say:3:1620231002:1.source_cn: 骑士休·格伦沃顿，现在感觉怎么样？

say:4:1620231003:1.source_cn: 再好不过了，公主殿下，谢谢您。

say:5:1620231004:1.text: Don't be so tense. Keep the knightly talk for later and take it easy now.
say:5:1620231004:1.source_cn: 别这么紧张，什么誓言呀、信念呀，那些庄严的场面话还是放...

say:7:1620231005:1.text: Well... I can feel my blood racing with excitement! At the same time, I feel a heavy sense of duty on my shoulders.
say:7:1620231005:1.source_cn: 其实……我很激动、很兴奋，也有了比以往更重的责任感。

say:8:1620231006:1.text: This is the first step of a long journey before me.
say:8:1620231006:1.source_cn: 我也知道这只是一个开始，我还有很长的路要走，但我已经迈...

say:9:1620231007:1.text: I'll keep going along this path.
say:9:1620231007:1.source_cn: 我会向着我认定的方向，一直走下去的。

choice_prompt:10:1620231007.text: I'll keep going along this path.
choice_prompt:10:1620231007.source_cn: 我会向着我认定的方向，一直走下去的。

say:11:1620231009:1.text: By the way, my mother said that the knighthood is meant as recognition and encouragement. It doesn't bind you to follow in your ancestors' footsteps as a knight.
say:11:1620231009:1.source_cn: 对了，我母亲说，敕封你为骑士，是对你的认可和鼓励，可不...

say:12:1620231010:1.text: I've heard much about your talent in magic. For now, focus on your studies at the Serene Lyceum. You could become both a great mage and a skilled knight in the future!
say:12:1620231010:1.source_cn: 听说你的魔法天赋很不错，好好在莱希拉姆进修吧，说不定你...

say:13:1620231011:1.text: When the time comes, I'll petition my mother to appoint you as a court mage!
say:13:1620231011:1.source_cn: 到时候我就向母亲请求，特聘你为宫廷魔法师！

say:14:1620231012:0.text: Thank you, Your Highness. I can't wait for that day to come.
say:14:1620231012:0.source_cn: 感谢你，公主殿下，我很期待那一天的到来。

say:16:1620231008:1.text: Haha, absolutely! Work hard, play hard—just like Magister Merlin!
say:16:1620231008:1.source_cn: 哈哈，当然了，我会效仿梅林大人，在紧张的工作和学习后给...
say:16:1620231008:1.male: Haha, absolutely! Work hard, play hard—just like Magister Merlin!
say:16:1620231008:1.female: Haha, absolutely! Work hard, play hard—just like Magister Merlin!
